verdict.rationale: gstack is designed around skill-based routing where a user's natural-language request ('gstack request') is dispatched to the right skill (planning, review, QA, shipping, debugging, docs, security, design) per gstack-docs-18, and community evidence confirms it operates as an agent responding to natural-language product/engineering questions (gstack-comm-1). However, evidence doesn't show a broad general-purpose NL command interface beyond routing to predefined skills, nor independent verification of robustness across arbitrary phrasing. missing for 10: evidence of open-ended NL command handling outside the fixed skill set, hands-on demonstration of ambiguous/novel command interpretation, and independent corroboration beyond one HN thread.
